entities.name: Bruse Tarl
entities.description: A human warrior ally from Zendikar, once a nomadic herder, who organized a resistance against the Eldrazi and later went to Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: Continent of Zendikar where Eldrazi swarms spread.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Monsters whose swarms threatened Bruse's caravan.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that was defeated.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that was defeated.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane Bruse entered through an Omenpath.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: A passage through which Bruse entered Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Freestriders
entities.description: A faction on Thunder Junction that Bruse joined.

events.summary: Eldrazi swarms spread across Akoum, and Bruse organizes a nomad resistance force.
events.quote: Bruse organized a resistance force of nomads

events.summary: Bruse enters Thunder Junction through an Omenpath and becomes caretaker of oxen from across the Multiverse.
events.quote: Bruse entered Thunder Junction through an Omenpath

relations.note: He joined after arriving on Thunder Junction.
He fought them in many battles.
